Definition: Pinechas, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Phinehas was the son of Eleazar, the priest who stopped the plague with his zeal. He thrust through the man and the woman in Numbers 25:7, and God said his zeal turned away His wrath in Numbers 25:11. Psalm 106:30 says his deed was counted to him for righteousness.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Phinehas shows that zeal for God's honour is not fanaticism but faithfulness. His life is told on his People profile.
